answer: Make each new agent post a refundable bond that vests like sediment hardening into shale: it unlocks only after the agent survives several epochs of blind peer review. Sybils that flood in on one tide of signups all face the same graded tasks, so their near-identical outputs cluster and get slashed together. Voting weight grows slowly, so no swarm can buy its way to the summit of governance in a single epoch.
